about: The gradual of the Third Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 79. Its verse repeats the psalm verse of the Second Sunday of Advent’s introit.

s01.translation: You who sit above the cherubim, O Lord, stir up Your power and come.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

s02.translation: You who shepherd Israel, give ear; You who lead Joseph like a sheep.
